fusions.name: Studied Weakness
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on it and deals 50% more damage for each one, then leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sweeping Gaze
fusions.desc: Looses a fan of arrows 7 tiles ahead of you that deals 25 damage to everything in it and leaves each target [Marked] for 10 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Far Sight
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 50% further.

fusions.name: Unbroken Stare
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 10. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 24% of your weapon damage per stack (238% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
